_eligibility_text: Following are the eligibility criteria that a PwD should have to be enrolled under Disha Centre: 1. PwD should be in the age group of 0-10 years. 1. PwD should have one of the disabilities covered under the [National Trust Act, 1999](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3300891a62162b960cf02ce3827bb363c/uploads/2024/09/20240918793880368.pdf), which are Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities.
